reasoning: No recent, state-specific general-election polling for Oregon’s 2026 Senate or the presidential race appears in the last 45 days, but structural and expert-context sources all point to a solid Democratic advantage. Cook’s statewide PVI of D+8 and a Solid/Safe Democratic rating for Jeff Merkley’s 2026 Senate race, combined with market odds and analytical coverage describing the seat as a safe hold, support treating Oregon as roughly D+8 or a bit more Democratic-leaning than the nation in both Senate and presidential contests right now. Within the last 45 days, nothing credible suggests a Republican edge; at most, registration trends show a modest narrowing but still a clear Democratic lead statewide.
